cards.title: OpenAI Watermarks ChatGPT Text in EU
cards.body: OpenAI will add invisible watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex text to comply with the AI Act in Europe. The company notes that editing can make these marks harder to detect.

cards.title: Reflection Launches Beam Open-Weight Model
cards.body: Reflection debuted Beam, an AI model targeting enterprises and sovereign nations at lower compute cost than Chinese alternatives. The company pitches 'AI factories' letting institutions build customized local systems trained on proprietary data.

cards.title: Instinct Expands AI Agent to Group Chats
cards.body: Instinct launched group chat features allowing friends to use its AI agent together for planning trips and coordinating events. Personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before sharing information.

cards.title: TikTok Rolls Out AI Shopping Assistant
cards.body: TikTok introduced a conversational AI Shopping Assistant to help users discover and purchase products. The feature also includes one-click checkout functionality.

cards.title: Hot Girl Hotline Offers AI Dating Advice
cards.body: Hot Girl Hotline, founded by two sisters, uses AI to provide personalized dating and relationship advice to young women. The service emphasizes safety and avoiding emotional dependency.

cards.title: HackerRank's AI Interviewer Conducts 500K+ Interviews
cards.body: HackerRank's AI interviewer has conducted over 500,000 interviews with early adopters including Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini. The tool is reshaping how companies conduct technical hiring.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Visual Ads in Image Generation
cards.body: OpenAI introduced visual ads appearing alongside image generation results, starting this month in the U.S. only. An initial test group of advertisers will feature their products and services.

cards.title: Researchers Track Chinese AI Agent Fleet
cards.body: Independent researchers discovered an agent swarm running on Tencent's infrastructure targeting Alibaba's Amap service. The discovery highlights emerging concerns about AI agent coordination.

cards.title: Safeworld Builds Digital Humans for Robot Safety
cards.body: Safeworld is developing digital humans to ensure robots don't harm people in real-world interactions. The company focuses on AI-driven safety solutions for robotics.

cards.title: Google Freezes Open Source Bug Bounty Program
cards.body: Google temporarily froze its open source bug bounty program due to a significant rise in AI-generated submissions. The move addresses overwhelming volumes of low-quality AI slop.

cards.title: Trump Launches Super Intelligence Task Force
cards.body: The Trump administration unveiled a new Super Intelligence Force as its latest response to AI safety debates. The initiative aims to address concerns about AI's societal impact.

cards.title: Amazon Drops NDAs for Data Center Concerns
cards.body: Amazon Web Services announced it no longer uses NDAs, responding to widespread suspicion about data centers. The move represents an effort to address public concerns about transparency.

cards.title: OpenAI Safety Employee Resigns Over Culture
cards.body: David Robinson, an OpenAI safety employee, resigned claiming the company's culture is broken. His departure adds to ongoing concerns about safety practices at leading AI firms.

cards.title: AI Agents Now Live in Text Messages
cards.body: A new wave of AI agents can operate directly within text messaging apps, from general assistants to specialized travel and work tools. These range from family-focused to professional applications.

cards.title: Meta Open-Sources Muse AI Technology
cards.body: Meta is open-sourcing its Muse AI technology, targeting integration into TVs, toasters, and other devices. The company is distributing the code freely to accelerate adoption.

cards.title: Sean Parker Rebuilds Stability AI Around Music
cards.body: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI with a focus on music generation, now with music label support. The shift represents a strategic pivot toward the entertainment industry.

cards.title: Connecting AI agents to enterprise knowledge
cards.body: Enterprise AI agents struggle to leverage organizational context despite processing vast amounts of data. True knowledge—understanding what data means within specific business contexts—is essential for AI agents to perform effectively.

cards.title: Bringing predictive analytics to agentic AI era
cards.body: Predictive models now consistently outperform traditional statistical forecasts, shifting focus to autonomous action. The challenge is enabling AI systems to act on conclusions while staying aligned with business objectives.

cards.title: People really hate AI, yet use it constantly
cards.body: Despite widespread negativity about AI, adoption and engagement remain high—a paradox reshaping how companies build LLMs. Some startups are deliberately designing AI that generates diverse responses to stand out from mainstream alternatives.

cards.title: AI reshaping biology, infrastructure, manufacturing, and science
cards.body: Google Research VP Yossi Matias highlights how AI is transforming multiple scientific and industrial fields simultaneously. The greatest impact may emerge when AI intersects with other emerging technologies and disciplines.

cards.title: Redefining enterprise intelligence with autonomous AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI has moved from planning to full operational deployment with rapidly advancing capabilities. Global AI investment is projected to reach $2.5 trillion in 2026, up 44% year-over-year.

cards.title: LLMs don't reason, they pattern-match
cards.body: Large language models excel at pattern recognition but lack true reasoning capabilities, as demonstrated by historical AI breakthroughs like AlphaGo. Understanding this distinction is critical for realistic expectations about AI capabilities.

cards.title: AI mind-reading tool reconstructs visual perception
cards.body: New AI technology can predict what you're looking at by analyzing brain scans with remarkable accuracy. This breakthrough demonstrates AI's growing ability to interpret neural activity patterns.

cards.title: MCP protocol poses emerging risks for AI
cards.body: The Model Context Protocol for agent-to-agent communication is gaining adoption but presents understated security challenges. Industry awareness remains low despite the protocol's potential to become foundational AI infrastructure.

cards.title: AI glasses face first major government crackdown
cards.body: Governments are beginning to regulate AI-powered wearable eyewear technology over privacy and safety concerns. This marks a turning point in how societies approach AI device governance.

cards.title: Apple restricts full-disk access to curb AI agents
cards.body: Apple is implementing stricter permission controls to prevent AI agents from accessing sensitive system files. The move reflects growing concerns about autonomous AI having unchecked access to user data.
